entities.summary: Thammanoon Niyomtrong, known by his ring name Knockout CP Freshmart, is a Thai professional boxer and former Muay Thai fighter. As a professional boxer, he won world titles in two weight divisions having held the World Boxing Association (WBA) between 2016 to 2024, and the World Boxing Council (WBC) light-flyweight title from 2025 to 2026.
